Priya Ramanathan
Data Privacy & Security Specialist — Public Sector & Healthcare
Profile
Data privacy and security specialist with 7 years of experience conducting compliance assessments and
leading data protection workstreams for healthcare and government IT projects. Experienced with health
data protection regulations, third-party security audits, and Data Processing Agreements.
Relevant Experience
Data Privacy Lead — Regional Health Records Digitization Program (2022–2023)
l
Led the data protection impact assessment for a case management system handling sensitive patient
records across 15 facilities.
l
Coordinated a third-party security audit prior to go-live and drafted the resulting remediation plan.
l
Authored the data retention and deletion policy adopted by the client's IT governance board.
Security Compliance Consultant — Public Sector Case Management Rollouts (2019–2022)
l
Advised on role-based access control design and audit logging requirements across three separate
government case-tracking projects.
Certifications
l
CIPP/E (Certified Information Privacy Professional/Europe)
l
CISSP
